_comment: Copy this file to ops-alert.config.json (gitignored) on the PROD server and fill it in. Used by backup-db.ps1 and healthcheck.ps1.

smtp._comment: SMTP used ONLY for ops alert emails (backup/health), independent of the app's mail. ALL sending goes via SMTP2GO/SendGrid (NOT Zoho — Zoho is receiving only). Use an SMTP2GO SMTP user; port 587 (STARTTLS), NOT 465. 'from' MUST be a @gndj.org address (verified sender domain, so DKIM/SPF align).

_comment_alertTo: Where ops alerts (backup status + site down/recovered + audit-archive sync) are emailed. Put the ADMIN + CHEF(S) DE GROUPE addresses here (one or more).

backup._comment_dir: dir = local folder for the nightly database dumps (gndj_*.dump). Kept in its own database subfolder, next to audit/ and documents/.
backup._comment_rclone: rcloneRemote = 'remoteName:folder' created by 'rclone config' (e.g. Box: 'gndj-cloud:GNDJ-Backups'). Leave empty to keep backups LOCAL ONLY (not recommended). rcloneConfig points the SYSTEM task at the token you created under your user. rcloneExe = FULL path to rclone.exe — set this so the SYSTEM scheduled task finds rclone even when a user-scoped winget install isn't on the machine PATH (find it with: (Get-Command rclone).Source).
backup._comment_audit: auditArchiveDir = the folder the APP writes the yearly audit-log CSV archives to. MUST match the app's AuditArchive:Directory in appsettings.Production.json (put it OUTSIDE the site so a deploy never wipes it). backup-db.ps1 rclone-syncs it to <rcloneRemote>/audit (kept, never pruned). Leave empty to skip the off-server audit sync.
backup._comment_documents: documentArchiveDir = the folder the APP writes the new-year document archives (zip of every document, once per scout year) to. MUST match DocumentArchive:Directory in appsettings.Production.json (outside the site). backup-db.ps1 rclone-syncs it to <rcloneRemote>/documents (kept, never pruned). Leave empty to skip.
